- Density (ρ) ≈ 1.5 g/cm³ (approximated from standard reference data)

**Formula:**
\[ V = \frac{m}{\rho} \]

**Calculation:**
\[ V = \frac{312 \text{ g}}{1.5 \text{ g/mL}} = 208 \text{ mL} \]
